original_submission.content:
import sys
sys.path.append('storage/shared')
from meta.anomaly_experiments.stats_utils import summarize_file, md_table, read_jsonl
import json
from pathlib import Path
import pandas as pd

# Path to results
results_path = 'storage/shared/meta/anomaly_experiments/cooldown_ladder/zephyr/results_v1_1.jsonl'
output_path = 'storage/shared/meta/anomaly_experiments/cooldown_ladder/zephyr/analysis_v2.md'

# Extract numeric deltas
df = read_jsonl(results_path)
if 'delta_tokens' in df.columns:
    df['numeric_delta'] = df['delta_tokens'].apply(lambda d: d.get('written', 0) * 1000 if isinstance(d, dict) else d)  # Placeholder; adjust based on actual delta meaning

# Run summary on numeric_delta
summ = summarize_file(results_path, group_by='cooldown_label')

# Generate Markdown
lines = ["# Extended Ladder Analysis v2"]
if summ["stats"]:
    s = summ["stats"]
    lines.append(f"## Overall Stats\n- n={s['n']}, mean={s['mean']:.1f}, median={s['median']:.1f}, MAD={s['mad']:.1f}, std={s['std']:.1f}")
if summ["groups"]:
    cols = ["cooldown_label", "n", "mean", "median", "mad", "std"]
    lines.append("## Group Stats")
    lines.append(md_table(summ["groups"], cols))
if summ.get("half_life"):
    lines.append(f"## Decay Fit\n- Half-life: {summ['half_life']:.2f} ticks")
if summ.get("ascii_plot"):
    lines.append("## ASCII Plot\n```\n" + summ['ascii_plot'] + "\n```")
if summ.get("plot_path"):
    lines.append(f"## Plot\nSaved to: {summ['plot_path']}")

# Write output
Path(output_path).write_text("\n".join(lines))
print("\n".join(lines))
print(json.dumps(summ, indent=2))
